_about: Kiwix pack families for catalog_gen.py: category, license, hold and readiness domain per family, verified against each source on 2026-10-20 (source = where the license is stated). A pack whose family has no row, a null license or a hold is left out (Neal, 2026-10-20: families with no stated license are listed as "Not stated by the source"); the first matching row wins, so a family's sub-rows (Wikipedia's subject packs, the Stack Exchange sites, LibreTexts) come before its catch-all. match is a regex on the ZIM name, or {"kiwixCategory": …}. domain is one of the nine readiness domains (medicine, food, making, science, technology, maps, reference, literature, thought; Plan H1, spec 2026-10-21-home-readiness-onboarding-design.md §3) or null for families that count in storage only.
